title: Jammy Dense Filipino Yuzu Chicken Pancit Bihon
description: A festive Filipino dish featuring yuzu and a pasta water emulsion, high in protein and served in a ceramic tagine. This dish is a variation of the traditional pancit bihon, with a jammy and dense texture.
instructions: Cook the pancit bihon noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until browned.
Add the yuzu juice, rice vinegar, soy sauce, and patis, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the tagine and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot in the ceramic tagine.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
